mapper.select: SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = false
SELECT p.* FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON p.id = pm.project_id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_deleted = false ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (name, description, owner_id, start_date, end_date, status, visibility) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{visibility})
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE projects SET is_deleted = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
